claim: Innovators capture about 2.2 percent of the total social surplus from innovation (U.S. nonfarm business sector, 1948-2001).

source.label: William D. Nordhaus, 'Schumpeterian Profits in the American Economy: Theory and Measurement', NBER Working Paper 10433 (April 2004), Conclusion
source.quote: Using data from the U.S. nonfarm business section, I estimate that innovators are able to capture about 2.2 percent of the total social surplus from innovation.
